content.ko:

content.en:
[Ch 1. The Slow Train Whistle and Dry Corn]
A 500-page Haruki-style psychological faction capturing the inner void of a political titan. 'The world turns as mercilessly as a factory press, and each of us carries a broken joint.' Ambition begun with a crushed arm, tragic family estrangement, and the snow falling upon Seocho Court.

［１章。完行列車の奇跡音と乾いたトウモロコシ]
